audience: sales and HR teams that send contracts for signature with eSignatures

useCases.title: Read the status of a sent contract
useCases.text: Get a contract's status, signers and PDF link. Then read its body as Markdown. Do not repeat the call in a loop.

useCases.title: Find a template and its placeholders
useCases.text: List the templates, then read one template's body with its placeholder keys.

useCases.title: Draft a contract from a template
useCases.text: Create a contract from a template with save_as_draft set to yes, so nothing is sent. Then set its placeholder values.

useCases.title: Send a draft after adding a signer
useCases.text: Add a signer to a draft contract. Then send the draft to its signers by e-mail or SMS.

useCases.title: Withdraw a contract before it is signed
useCases.text: Withdraw a contract that should not be signed. A signed contract cannot be withdrawn.
